notes: The digression «قلت لسهيل إن عمرا حدثنا عن القعقاع عن أبيك» belongs to a different chain of Sufyan's; it is left out of this saying's route
The report's remark «ورجوت أن يسقط عني رجلا» is Sufyan's aside, not a link
Whether the digression's route is a second isnad of this saying is not settled by the rules
